user.title: Appliance notifications

data_description.auto_discover: Turn off to be offered each appliance found, and choose which to add

power.title: Power Monitored Appliance
power.description: For any appliance on a smart plug or other power monitor. It starts when its power goes above the threshold, and ends once it has stayed at or below it for the grace period.

data_description.name: Used in notifications, and to choose an icon
data_description.power_entity: The sensor measuring the power drawn by the appliance
data_description.threshold: The appliance is running while it draws more than this
data_description.grace_period: How long the power must stay at or below the threshold before the cycle is over, so short drop outs are ignored
data_description.min_duration: How long the power must have been above the threshold before it counts as a cycle, so a door opened or a button pressed is ignored
data_description.switch_entity: The switch the appliance is plugged into, offered as a button to switch it off once it has finished
data_description.switch_off_button: Put a Switch Off button for the smart plug on the end notification. Turn off for a plug that should stay on.

confirm.title: Notifications for {name}
confirm.description:
Get told when {name} starts and finishes?

{supernotify}

abort.already_configured: This appliance is already set up
abort.already_in_progress: Set up of this appliance is already in progress

discovery.title: Automatic discovery
discovery.description: With automatic discovery, every supported appliance is set up for you, now and whenever you add another. Appliances already set up are left as they are.

data_description.auto_discover: Turn off to be offered each appliance found, and choose which to add

data_description.notify_start: Send a notification when the appliance starts. When off, the Live Activity is still opened, silently and on phones only.
data_description.notify_end: Send a notification when the appliance finishes. When off, the Live Activity is still closed.
data_description.notify_phase: Send a notification when a phase of the cycle is over, such as an oven getting up to heat. When off, it is only shown on the Live Activity.
data_description.dashboard: Opened when a notification or the Live Activity is tapped. Leave empty to open the app where it was.
data_description.notify_progress: Send a notification every 10% of the cycle. When off, progress is only shown on the progress bar of the Live Activity, which is updated silently.
data_description.program_in_title: Show the program beside the name on the Live Activity, such as "Dishwasher · Eco 50ºC", whenever there's a time left to show, which on an iPhone's Lock Screen takes the place of the message. Turn off if the program names are too long to fit.

start.name: Start message
start.description: Sent when the appliance starts. Clear a box to go back to the usual wording. Put {program_placeholder} where the program under way should be named.

end.name: End message
end.description: Sent when the appliance finishes. Clear a box to go back to the usual wording. Put {program_placeholder} where the program that ran should be named.

data_description.reminder: Minutes after which the end is sent again, until Finished is pressed on the notification. 0 for none. Remind Later on the notification waits this long, or 30 minutes.
data_description.reminder_repeats: How many times the end is sent again

notify.name: Notification targets
notify.description: Who and what is notified. Leave everything empty for the usual choice.

data_description.targets: Notify entities to send to. Leave empty for every phone with the Home Assistant app.
data_description.target: Who or what to notify, as for any Supernotify notification. Leave empty for Supernotify to choose.
data_description.custom_target: Targets outside of Home Assistant, such as e-mail addresses or phone numbers.
data_description.deliveries: Limit notifications to these Supernotify deliveries. Leave empty for Supernotify to choose.
